answer.rationale: Prioritize an expedited incumbent negotiation with market benchmarking, seeking the mandated cost reduction through price, payment, and multi-year volume terms while preserving incumbent delivery continuity. With only 14 days to expiry and no production buffer, a primary-vendor switch creates unacceptable delivery risk; the low-cost alternative's repeated SLA misses rule out sole-source use on this critical line. Verify the prior benchmark-driven concession record and the alternative vendor's delivery record before committing.
